environment.description: Service deployed on EKS cluster behind AWS NLB (Network Load Balancer) in TCP passthrough mode. NLB forwards raw TCP to pod port 8443. No ingress controller, no TLS termination at load balancer. Service is exposed to internal VPC CIDR 10.0.0.0/8. Any host on the VPC can establish WebSocket connections directly. Kubernetes NetworkPolicy allows ingress from all pods in namespace. No authentication middleware configured on the service.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB, TCP passthrough, no TLS termination
